high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from Fortune.com, captured at 12:05 PM. The page features an article titled "Tech CEOs on what the future of work will look like in an AI world." The header includes the Fortune logo on the left and a red "SUBSCRIBE" button on the right. The main content of the article discusses how technology leaders, including Bill Gates, envision the impact of AI on the future of work. It mentions that while many agree AI will change the landscape, there is disagreement on how it will reshape the rules.
